<div class="card-body">
'''Trooper Charge''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国兵員の突撃</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘に参加している自分の兵員／トルーパーを１名選び、“突撃”させる。突撃した兵員が「デス・スター兵員」なら戦闘力＋３、それ以外の兵員なら戦闘力＋２する。その兵員は戦闘の終了時に没収される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-274o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の兵員は軍規に盲従し、恐れを知らない。銀河最強の武器や宇宙船を与えられた彼等は、自らを無敵と信じて疑わない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Trooper Charge.

'''Card text:''' Choose one of your participating troopers to charge. If it is a Death Star Trooper, add 3 to its power. Otherwise add 2. The trooper is forfeited at the end of the battle.

'''Lore:''' Imperial troops obey military discipline blindly and know no fear. Given the galaxy's most powerful weapons and starships, they have no doubt that they are invincible.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Trooper Charge]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
